item.title: Autonomous Weeder Robot
item.description: An autonomous robot that finds dandelions with machine vision, drives to them, and removes them mechanically. I led all work in software and autonomy.

item.title: EKF SLAM in ROS2
item.description: A ROS2 simulation of an omnidirectional robot that maps its surroundings while tracking its own position, using an extended Kalman filter, ICP scan matching, and an occupancy grid. Also includes an exploration of visual SLAM with ORB-SLAM3.

item.title: Wlkata Mirobot Robotic Arm Control
item.description: A ROS2 control stack for a physical 6-axis Wlkata Mirobot arm, built up from joint commands to an optimization-based inverse kinematics solver and pure pursuit tracking of paths the user draws.
